captureMethod: npm view package@version version dist.integrity --json; npm view package dist-tags --json

@fluentui/web-components.selectionRationale: Matches the checked-in FLUENT-WC-3.1.3-18-FAMILY-CROSSWALK.md component inventory and the latest tag captured on the review date.

@fluentui/react-components.selectionRationale: Retain the exact 9.74.10 npm tarball and integrity already pinned by the checked-in FLUENT-REACT-9.74.10-18-API-CANDIDATES.json. Latest is 9.74.11; do not silently change the audit baseline mid-review.

@fluentui/react-icons.selectionRationale: Matches the latest tag captured on the review date and the Fluent System Icons reference.

notes: Storybook deployments are live references and are not assumed to be release-pinned to the package versions above.
React v9 is a cross-platform fallback only where the pinned Web Components catalog lacks a comparable reference; it is not asserted to be a DOM/API 1:1.
No React v8 compatibility component is used as a React v9 reference.
A versioned package match does not imply Fluent parity acceptance.
